purpose: Both artifact trees are excluded from ordinary git collection, so publishing them means stating every file's byte size and sha256. Every number any record document quotes about an artifact or a log traces to an entry here.

Each member is published with its path relative to logs/, because a member absent from the manifest would be an unpublished file in a git-ignored tree.

cpg.what_is_here: A 33-byte symlink to the graph, which is host-global and shared read-only with concurrent clones. This checkout's own frontend invocation produced NO graph (run-record.md divergence D1), so there is no harness/artifacts/cpg/ directory to publish and none is invented.

record_of_account.agreement: both state these same bytes and digest
record_of_account.adjudicated_by: harness/lib/preflight_graph_identity.py, which resolves the record of account by provenance and refuses the Stage 3 runner on any mismatch

cpg.divergence: run-record.md D4: this pair is the third identity the path has held, and no load in this run read it. The counts reported in run-record.md section 5 belong to the pair each load actually read and are not restated for these bytes.
